title: LORD, TAKE OVER THE BATTLES I DO NOT UNDERSTAND
text: Beloved, before we go into the throne room this morning, I want you to do something for me. Share this [music] prayer with someone. There is somebody on your contact list. There is somebody in your family. There is somebody you know who is fighting battles they cannot understand. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes that two are better [music] than one and a three-fold cord is not easily broken. When you share this word, you are not just sharing information. You are becoming a distributor of divine intervention. You are becoming a channel through which the Holy Ghost [music] will locate somebody who is about to give up. So right now press that share button. Send it to that WhatsApp group. Send it to that family member. Post it on your status. Let the anointing that is about to be released find expression in the lives of many. Glory to God. Now I want you to understand something today. There is a dimension of spiritual warfare that many believers are not prepared for. We have been taught how to pray. We have been taught how to fast. We have been taught how to decree and declare. But there is a category of battles that require a different approach entirely. These are battles that you cannot decode with your natural [music] intelligence. These are battles where the enemy's strategy is so complex, so layered, so mysterious that your human wisdom becomes insufficient. This is why David said in Psalm 18, "The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold. David understood that there are dimensions of warfare where your only solution is to conscript the commander of heaven's armies into your situation. I need you to understand today that there are battles in your life right now that are beyond your pay grade. There are warfare strategies being deployed against you from the kingdom of darkness that require divine intelligence to decode. The enemy knows that if he fights you in a way that you can understand, you will resist him. So what does he do? He launches attacks from blind spots. He orchestrates situations that seem random, that appear coincidental, that look natural, but in the realm of the spirit, they are carefully coordinated assaults against your destiny. And this is where many believers are losing ground because they are trying to fight battles they were never meant to understand with their natural mind. Listen to me carefully. There is a difference between fighting your battles and God taking over your battles. When you fight your battles, you are limited by what you can see, what you know, and what you can do. But when God takes over, he sees what you cannot see. He knows what you do not know, and he can do what you cannot do. The Bible says in Exodus 14:14, "The Lord will fight for you. You need only to be still." THIS IS NOT PASSIVITY. This is strategic positioning. There are moments in spiritual warfare where your activity becomes your enemy. There are seasons where your best strategy is to stand still and watch [music] the salvation of the Lord. I remember the story of Jehoshaphat in 2 Chronicles chapter [music] 20. The Bible says that a vast army was coming against Judah. And when Jehoshaphat had heard about it, he was alarmed and resolved to inquire of the Lord. Notice that his first instinct was not to gather his military generals. His first instinct was not to strategize with his adviserss. His first instinct was to seek the face of God. And I want to tell you tonight that when you are facing battles you do not understand, your first port of call should not be human counsel. [music] Your first point of contact should be the throne room of grace because there are battles where if God doesn't show you what is happening in the spirit realm, you will fight shadows while the real enemy operates undetected. Jehoshaphat prayed a prayer that I want us to examine. [music] He said in verse 12, "We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you." This is one of the most powerful prayers in scripture. It is a prayer of absolute dependence. It is a prayer that says, "God, I am not pretending to [music] have answers. I am not coming to you with a plan that I want you to bless. I am coming to you with confusion, with bewilderment, with questions that have no human answers. And I am fixing my gaze on you." There is a grace that is released when you come before God with [music] that level of honesty. When you stop pretending to have it all together and you say, "Lord, take over this battle because I do not understand what [music] is happening." You see, the enemy specializes in complex warfare. He will attack your finances in a way that makes no sense. You are working hard. You are diligent. You are faithful with your tithes and offerings. But somehow money keeps slipping through your fingers like water. That is not natural. That is spiritual. He will attack your health in a way that confuses medical doctors. They run tests and find nothing. Yet you know something is wrong in your body. That is not ordinary. That is warfare. He will attack your relationships in a way that defies logic. People who love you suddenly turn against you for no reason. Friends become enemies overnight. That is not coincidence. That is coordinated spiritual assault. And when these things happen, many believers make the mistake of trying to understand it with their natural mind. They start analyzing what did I do wrong? Where did I miss it? What is happening? And while they are busy analyzing, the enemy continues his operations unhindered. But tonight, I want you to pray a different prayer. I want you to say, "Lord, I'm not going to waste time trying to decode what [music] the enemy is doing. I am handing this battle over to you. You understand what I do not understand. You see what I CANNOT SEE. TAKE OVER THIS BATTLE in Jesus name." The principle I am sharing with you tonight is what I call divine conscription. It is when you draft God into your situation as the chief commander. It is when you acknowledge that you are out of your depth and you need heaven's intervention. The Bible says in Isaiah 55 to89, "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, declares the Lord. [music] As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts." What this means is that God operates on a frequency that is beyond human comprehension. his strategies, his methods, his timing, they all transcend natural understanding. So when you are facing battles you do not understand, you are actually being positioned to witness the supernatural. Because understand this, battles that make sense can be fought with natural weapons. But battles that defy logic require supernatural intervention. And sometimes God allows you to encounter battles that confuse you so that you will stop depending on your own understanding and learn to lean wholly on him. Proverbs 3:5-6 says, "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding. In all your ways, submit to him and he will make your path straight." That word lean means to support yourself with. God is saying do not support yourself with your own understanding when you are dealing with battles that are beyond you. I want to prophesy to someone today that battle that has kept you awake, that situation that has stolen your peace, that problem that has defied every solution you have tried, the Lord says it is about to experience divine takeover. God is about to step into that situation in a way that will leave you in awe. You are about to see manifestations of God's power that will erase every doubt you have ever had about his ability to intervene. The God who parted the Red Sea, the God who made the sun stand still. The God who shut the mouths of lions, the God who brought down the walls of Jericho, that same God is taking over your battles tonight. Let me show you something in the life of Moses. When Israel was trapped at the Red Sea with Pharaoh's army behind them and water in front of them, the people panicked. They started complaining to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us to die in the wilderness?" But Moses said something profound in Exodus 14:13:14. "Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the Lord will bring you today." The Egyptians you see today, you will never see again. The Lord will fight for you. You need only to be still. Moses understood something that the people did not understand. He understood that when you are facing impossible situations, your deliverance is not in your activity but in God's intervention. And look at what happened. God told Moses to stretch out his hand over the sea and the waters divided. Israel walked through on dry ground while the same sea that was their pathway became Pharaoh's graveyard. This is what happens when God takes over your battles. The very thing that the enemy meant to destroy you becomes the instrument of your testimony. The very situation that look like your end becomes the platform for God's glory. I am prophesying to somebody tonight. What the enemy meant for evil, God is turning around for your good. That battle you do not understand is actually setting you up for a testimony that will bring glory to God. Now, there is something I need you to understand about battles you do not understand. Many times these battles are orchestrated by territorial principalities that have been assigned against your bloodline, your destiny or your assignment. The Bible speaks clearly about the hierarchy of darkness. Ephesians 6:12 says, "For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms." Notice the plural rulers, authorities, powers, spiritual forces. This tells you that the kingdom of darkness is organized. It is structured. And sometimes the battles you are facing are not just random attacks. They are strategic operations by highranking demonic entities. This is why some battles persist despite your prayers and fasting. You are dealing with principalities that have been entrenched for generations. You are dealing with covenants that were made before you were born. You are dealing with altars that have been speaking against your destiny before you became aware of your purpose. And the truth is you cannot fight these battles with natural wisdom. You cannot fight generational causes [music] with positive thinking. You cannot fight territorial spirits with motivational speeches. You need the intervention of the one who has all authority in heaven and on earth. Jesus said in Matthew 28-18, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me." This means that no matter what principality is fighting you, no matter what power is resisting you, no matter what authority is standing against you, Jesus has superior authority. And when you invite him to take over your battles, you are not just calling for help. You are invoking the highest authority in the universe. You are bringing the name that is above every name into your situation. You are releasing the power that created galaxies into your problem. And I want to tell you tonight, there is no battle too [music] complex for Jesus. There is no situation too mysterious for the Holy Spirit. There is no problem too difficult for the God who spoke everything into existence. Can I tell you about Daniel? In Daniel chapter 10, we see something remarkable. Daniel had been praying and fasting for 21 days, seeking understanding about a vision. But nothing seemed to be happening. Unknown to Daniel, his prayer had been heard from the first day. But there was warfare in the heavenlies. The prince of Persia, a territorial spirit, was resisting the angel that was bringing the answer to Daniel. It took the intervention of Michael, one of the chief princes, to break through that resistance. Now, if Daniel had judged his situation by what he could see, he would have concluded that God was not answering. But what he could not see was that there was a battle raging in the spirit realm over his breakthrough. This is what I want you to understand tonight. There are battles happening over your life right now that you cannot see with your physical eyes. There are wrestling matches taking place in the heavenly realms over your destiny. There are confrontations happening between angels and demons over your breakthrough. And the reason you do not understand what is going on is because you are looking at the natural circumstances while the real war is taking place in the spirit. This is why you need to pray Lord take over the battles I do not understand because God sees what is happening in both realms. He knows exactly what kind of resistance you are facing and he knows exactly how to dismantle it. Let me give you another example from scripture in 2 Kings chapter 6. The king of Aram was at war with Israel and every time he made plans to attack the prophet Elisha would warn the king of Israel. This happened so many times that the king of Aram became furious and thought there was a spy in his camp. But one of his officers said, "Elish the prophet who is in Israel tells the king of Israel, the very words you speak in your bedroom." So the king sent a strong force to capture Elisha. When Elisha's servant woke up the next morning and saw the army surrounding the city, he panicked. He said, "What shall we do?" But Elisha's response was calm. Don't be afraid. Those who are with us are more than those who are with them. Then Elisha prayed that God would open the servant's eyes. And when God did, the servant saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha. Do you see what happened? The servant was panicking because all he could see was the physical army. But Elisha was calm because he could see the spiritual reinforcements. And I want to tell you tonight, the reason you do not need to panic about that battle you do not understand is because if your spiritual eyes were opened, you would see that heaven's armies are already positioned for your defense. You would see that angels have been dispatched to fight on your behalf. You would see that divine strategies are already in place for your victory. The battle may be confusing to you, but it is not confusing to God. And when you say, "Lord, take over," you are activating heaven's intervention in your situation. There is a warfare strategy that I want to teach you tonight. It is what I call the prayer of surrender. This is not a prayer of defeat. It is a prayer of delegation. It is when you say, "God, I am not abandoning the fight, but I am changing my position in the battle. I am moving from the front line to the place of intercession. I am moving from trying to figure it out to trusting you to work it out. This kind of prayer carries tremendous power because it is rooted in faith. It is a declaration that you trust God's ability more than you trust your own efforts. It is an acknowledgment that his ways are higher than your ways and his thoughts are higher than your thoughts. Listen, when you pray, Lord, take over the battles I do not understand, you are not being irresponsible. You are being wise. You are recognizing that there is a limit to what you can do. And you are inviting the one who has no limits to intervene. And the moment you pray that prayer with genuine faith, something shifts in the spirit realm. Reinforcements are deployed. Strategies are downloaded. The council of the wicked is frustrated. The plans of the enemy are exposed and dismantled. Because when God takes over a battle, he does not just fight. He dominates. He does not just defend, he conquers. He does not just protect, he advances. I want you to think about the battle of Jericho for a moment. When Joshua and the Israelites arrived at Jericho, they found the city fortified with walls so thick and high that it seemed impenetrable. Now, in natural warfare, you would expect God to give them a battering ram or a siege strategy. But God gave them a strange instruction. March around the city once a day for 6 days. And on the seventh day, march around it [music] seven times and shout. Can you imagine how confusing that must have been? But Joshua obeyed. And when they shouted, the walls came down. Why? Because this was a battle they were not meant to understand. This was a battle that required divine intervention, not human strategy. And when God takes over, he shows you that his methods are beyond your comprehension, but his results are undeniable. There is somebody reading this right now and you have been trying to bring down walls in your life with your own strength. You have been pushing, you have been striving, you have been working yourself to exhaustion, but those walls are still standing. Tonight, I want you to stop trying to figure it out and start trusting God to work it out. Those walls that have resisted your efforts are about to come down by divine decree. That marriage that seems beyond repair, God is taking over. That financial crisis that has defied every solution, God is taking over. That sickness that has baffled doctors, God is taking over. That addiction that has held you captive, God [music] is taking over. that business that is on the verge of collapse. God is taking over. Let me tell you something about God's takeover. When God steps into your situation, he does not come with half measures. He does not come with temporary fixes. He comes with permanent solutions. He comes with total victory. The Bible says in Romans 8:37, "In all these things, we are more than conquerors [music] through him who loved us." Not just conquerors, more than conquerors. That means we do not just win, we win decisively. We do not just survive, we thrive. We do not just get through. We come out better than we went in. And this is what happens when you allow God to take over your battles. Now, let me transition into a time of prayer because the Holy Spirit is already moving. I sense in my spirit that there are people reading this who have been at the point of giving up. You have fought until you are exhausted. You have prayed until you ran out of words. You have fasted until you became weak. But tonight, heaven is releasing fresh strength. The anointing that is on this word is going to locate you wherever you are. And you are going to experience divine intervention [music] that will change your story forever. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace on behalf of every person that is reading this prayer right now. Lord, you know the battles they are facing. You know the situations that have kept them awake at night. You know the problems that have stolen their joy and their peace. And Lord, tonight by the authority vested in me as your servant, I declare divine takeover over every battle that they do not understand. Every mystery, every confusion, every complexity. Lord, I ask that you unravel it by your power. I prophesy to that battle in your finances that makes no sense. [music] Every demonic embargo that has been placed on your wealth, I command it to be lifted right now in Jesus' name. Every satanic restriction that has been limiting your income, I break it by the blood of Jesus. Every covenant of poverty that has been speaking over your life, I renounce it and I cancel it by apostolic authority. And I decree that from this moment, divine prosperity will begin to flow into your life like a river. God is taking over your financial battles and you are about to experience supernatural provision that will shock you. I speak to that health condition [music] that has defied medical explanations. Every spirit of infirmity that has been troubling your body, I command it to leave right now in the name of Jesus. Every demonic manipulation that has been distorting your DNA, altering your cells, attacking your organs, I reverse it by the power of the Holy Ghost. I declare that the same spirit that raised Christ from the dead is quickening your mortal body right now. Healing is flowing into your system. Strength is being restored. Vitality is being renewed. that disease, that sickness, that affliction, it must bow to the name of Jesus. God is taking over your health battles and you are going to receive your healing. I prophesy to every relationship that has been under attack. That marriage that the enemy has been trying to destroy, [music] I declare restoration in Jesus name. Every spirit of division that has been sewing discord between you and your spouse, I bind it right now. Every external interference, every third party manipulation, [music] every generational pattern of broken marriages, I break it by the blood of Jesus. And I decree that divine love, divine understanding, divine unity is being released into your home. God is taking over your marital battles and your marriage is about to experience supernatural turnaround. Listen to me. Every battle that you have been fighting in secret, every struggle that you have been too ashamed to share with anyone, every warfare that has been happening in the privacy of your mind, God sees it, God knows it, and God is intervening right now. That addiction that has had you bound, that habit that has been controlling you, that temptation that has been defeating you, the power of the Holy Spirit is breaking every chain. I declare freedom over your life. I decree deliverance over your mind. You are not going back to that bondage. You are not returning to that pit. God is taking over and you are coming out. Father, I pray for every person whose destiny has been under satanic siege. Every witchcraft [music] operation that has been launched against their future, I command it to backfire right now in Jesus name. Every evil altar where their name has been mentioned, I decree that fire from heaven will consume those altars, every demonic covenant that was entered into without their knowledge or consent. I break it by the blood [music] of Jesus. And I declare that their destiny is released. Their purpose is activated. Their potential is unlocked. Nothing, and I mean nothing, will stop them from fulfilling their God-given assignment. I speak to that business that is on the brink of collapse. Every satanic [music] manipulation of the economy that is affecting your enterprise, I nullify it by the power of the most high God. Every evil hand that has been stealing from your business, I command those hands to wither right now. Every demonic attack on your customers, your clients, your contracts, I break it in Jesus name. And I decree supernatural turnaround. Divine ideas are being downloaded into your spirit. Strategic connections are being orchestrated by heaven. Favor is being released over your business. God is taking over and your business is about to experience unprecedented growth. Let me tell you something powerful. When God takes over your battles, he does not just give you victory. He gives you vengeance. The Bible says in Romans 12:19, "Vengeance is mine. I will repay, says the Lord." This means that God will deal with every enemy that has been fighting you. He will contend with those who contend [music] with you. He will fight those who fight you. And when God fights your battles, he does not play fair. He fights to destroy the works of darkness completely. I prophesy that every enemy that has been celebrating your setbacks is about to witness your comeback. Every mocker who laughed at your struggles is about to be silenced by your testimony. Every Goliath that has been intimidating you is about to fall before you. Every pharaoh that has been pursuing you is about to drown in his own Red Sea. God is taking over and your enemies are about to learn that it is a dangerous thing to fight against someone whom God has chosen to defend. Father, I pray for supernatural wisdom to be released right now. For every person who has been confused about which step to take, which decision to make, which direction to go, Lord, release the spirit of wisdom and revelation. Let them hear your voice clearly. Let them see your path distinctly. Remove every fog of confusion. Break every cloud of uncertainty and give them divine clarity that will lead them to their expected end. I speak to those who are in spiritual warfare that they cannot identify. That evil presence that you sense but cannot name. That oppression that you feel but cannot explain. That harassment that you experience but cannot understand. I command every hidden enemy to be exposed right now in Jesus name. Every assignment of the enemy that has been operating in secret, I bring it into the light and I decree that it shall not prosper. Every weapon formed against you shall not prosper. Every tongue that rises against you in judgment shall be condemned. This is your heritage as a servant of [music] the Lord. Let me give you a principle that will change your prayer life. When you are dealing with battles you do not understand, do not just pray for understanding, pray for victory. Because sometimes God will give you the victory before he gives you the understanding. Sometimes he will deliver you before he explains to you what you were being delivered from. And that is okay because your deliverance does not depend on your understanding. It depends on his power. So stop waiting to understand before you pray for breakthrough. Pray for breakthrough and the understanding will come later. Father, I thank you because even now as I'm praying, angels are being dispatched, demons are being displaced, curses are being broken, captives are being released, the blind are receiving sight, the deaf [music] are hearing your voice, the bound are being loosed, the oppressed are being liberated, and every person that is in agreement with this prayer is experiencing supernatural intervention right now. I declare that every battle that has lasted longer than it should is coming to an end tonight. Every warfare that has gone on for years, for decades, for generations, the Lord is putting a stop to it right now. This is your season of divine termination. God is terminating every cycle of defeat. He's terminating every pattern of failure. He's terminating every agenda of the enemy. And he's establishing his purposes in your life. Listen to me carefully. There is a sound in the realm of the spirit right now. It is the sound of chains breaking. It is the sound of prison doors opening. It is the sound of walls crumbling. It is the sound of enemies [music] falling. It is the sound of victory being released. Can you hear it? Even if you cannot hear it with your natural ears, hear it with your spirit. Victory is yours. Breakthrough is yours. Deliverance is yours. Freedom is yours. And nothing can stop what God has released over your life tonight. Father, I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I cover every person reading this with the blood. I protect them from every backlash of the enemy. I decree that no weapon fashioned against them shall prosper. I declare that they are hidden in the secret place of the most high. They are covered by the shadow of the almighty and no harm, no evil, no disaster shall come near their dwelling. And I prophesy your testimony. You are going to wake up tomorrow morning with fresh hope. You are going to sense a lifting in your spirit. Things that were confusing are going to start making sense. Doors that were closed are going to start opening. People who were against you are going to start favoring you. Situations that were impossible are going to start changing. Because when God takes over your battles, he does not [music] just fight, he finishes. He does not just start. He completes. He does not just begin. He brings to fulfillment. Glory to God. I release you into your victory. I release you into your breakthrough. I release you into your testimony. The Lord has taken over your battles. And from this moment, you are walking in divine dominance, divine authority, divine victory. It is done. In the mighty name of Jesus, we have prayed. Amen. and amen.
